verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm, not a software product. Bulk operations across many items is a software-tool axis, so the question is a category error for this kind of offering. Its legal-tech boilerplate and the software-supported YSolutions transparency-register service are delivered as advisory services, not as a user-operated tool, and nothing in the evidence shows a user-facing bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
